headline: Middlebury carries the conference alone into December
dek: With Williams, Tufts, Hamilton, and Colby all eliminated from postseason play, Middlebury heads into its December meeting with Calvin as the conference's sole remaining side. Across all competitions, Middlebury has earned thirteen wins against four draws and four losses, producing 38 goals while allowing eighteen.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring separates cleanly at the top and bottom of the conference: Tufts's 51 goals exceed the combined output of Bowdoin and Trinity (Conn.), while the middle of the league clusters tightly behind the leaders.

wire.line: Williams has allowed just nine goals while winning fifteen matches, yet Middlebury is the last conference side still playing.

findings.text: Williams conceded just nine goals across its fifteen wins, one draw, and three losses, scoring 44 times along the way.
